title: WLED usermod cdata.json manifest
description: Describes how a usermod's web UI source files are compiled into generated C headers at build time. Consumed by tools/cdata.js. Keep in sync with the validation in tools/cdata.js.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation. Ignored by the build.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Omit to use the baseline schema (implicit v1); only 1 is currently supported. A future breaking change would introduce version 2.

header.description: Header-generation operations. Each produces one generated .h file in the usermod's own directory.

ui.description: Contributions folded into one of WLED's own web UI bundles at build time, minified and compressed together with it. At most one entry per target.

srcDir.description: Folder, relative to the manifest, holding the source files. Defaults to "data".

output.description: Filename of the generated header, written into the usermod's own directory (e.g. "example_ui.h").

specs.description: One entry per source file / C symbol to embed in this header.

target.description: Which core UI bundle to extend. Only the main UI page ("index") accepts contributions today.

api.description: Version of the UI extension API (the WLED object handed to the module factory) this code is written against. Only 1 is currently supported.

srcDir.description: Folder, relative to the manifest, holding the source files. Defaults to "data".

module.description: Module name, used to namespace this usermod's templates and UI slots. Defaults to the name of the folder the manifest lives in; set it explicitly if that name is not usable here.

sources.description: Files to contribute, in load order. CSS is inlined into the page head; templates and scripts into the body, templates first. Each script is wrapped as WLED.module("<module>", function(WLED) { ... }).

anyOf.description: Source filename under srcDir; its type is inferred from the extension (.css, .htm/.html, .js).

type.description: How the file is spliced in, overriding what the extension implies. Required when the extension is not one of .css, .htm, .html or .js.

name.description: C symbol to generate; e.g. "PAGE_example" yields a PAGE_example[] PROGMEM array plus PAGE_example_length.

method.description: How the embedded data is encoded: gzip-compressed, verbatim text, or a raw byte array. Defaults to gzip.

filter.description: Pre-processing applied to the source before embedding. Defaults to what the file extension implies (.htm/.html -> html-minify, .css -> css-minify, .js -> js-minify, otherwise plain); set explicitly to override (e.g. "plain" for already-minified JS).

prepend.description: Raw-string delimiter prefix; only meaningful with the plaintext method.

append.description: Raw-string delimiter suffix; only meaningful with the plaintext method.
